Drinking a lot of wine (sacramental, of course)

You can loan me a little, right? I've got a sure thing. I'll double your money, guaranteed.

I'm a great gambler. I'm just bad at math and logic.

The sound of raucous applause, which you play back liberally

en.caption: Why Be a Hoardsperson?
rows: You once tried to dive into a huge pool of gold coins. It hurt.
You've been betrayed by your adventuring party before, and there's no way now that you'll trust anyone else to hold on to the loot
Once, through a series of increasingly complex negotiations, you traded a paper clip for temporary control of a minor fiefdom.
Material possessions don't mean that much to you. Or at least that's the story you're going with.
You've never had a problem spending other people's money. Surely keeping other people's money can't be that hard.
You believe there's no such thing as worthless goods. Only unmotivated buyers.
You're not a hoarder. More of a passionate collector. You can stop anytime you want. Really.
Given the personalities of the other party members, it was mutually agreed that you were the only one who could be trusted
en.name: Why Be a Hoardsperson?

en.caption: Reliable Connections
rows: {@b Kim the Kid}: The best fence in town.
{@b Jeremy Snoot}: The most easily intimidated customs official in the city. From blueprints of government buildings to shipping manifests, he's your halfling.
{@b York Battleby}: A dab hand at knitting and swinging a sword. He takes payment in liquor for either service.
{@b Diana Fenwick}: Noble who wants to play criminal; enthusiastic, inexperienced, and loaded.
{@b "G"}: The only thing known about this information broker is the dead-drop point where they exchange messages, and that they're never wrong.
{@b Teresa Clearlake}: If you're looking for a place to lie low, her funeral home is ideal.
{@b Jenkin Twotooth}: Always has a job for those looking to scrape together a few coins. Unfortunately, his teeth outnumber his scruples.
{@b "Mustard" Micah}: Famous for being able to get goods and people past any blockade. Provided you don't mind said goods or people smelling strongly of mustard for the next month.
en.name: Reliable Connections

en.caption: Where You First Dabbled in Alchemy
rows: You traveled with a charlatan alchemist for years, until they were arrested for selling fake healing potions. You still remember how to get the taste just right.
You were once the head dishwasher in a famous wizard's college.
One of your parents was a healer in a small outpost, and they taught you that even the most mundane flora and natural materials can be used to wondrous effect.
While lost in the Underdark, you were forced to consume mold, fungus, and insect parts to survive. You developed a taste for that sort of thing.
You think you might be addicted to holy water. You just can't stop drinking it long enough to find out for sure.
You were once the personnel manager of a struggling business and needed to come up with a herbal cure-all that would keep employees awake for eighteen-hour shifts. No one died. Mostly.
As the child of a wealthy and despotic noble, you learned to smell {@condition poisoned} pastries a mile off. A shame that your siblings weren't so talented.
As a server in a tavern, you refined the perfect hangover cure but never wrote the recipe down. Now you're desperate to recreate it.
en.name: Where You First Dabbled in Alchemy

en.caption: Legendary Catchphrases
rows: Looks like this is the end. So let's go back to the beginning.
There's only one way out of this pickle, and that's by breaking a few jars!
Looks like trouble has some vacation time coming up. So let's book it a nice inn.
We've got a real game of cat and mouse here... so it's time to eat some cheese.
It's always darkest before the dawn, except when the moon is full. So let's moon!
We might be beaten, but we're not beaten! Because "beaten" means different things in both those contexts!
"Surrender" is my middle name, but it was a family thing and I never use it!

en.name: Detrimental Manifestations
en.caption: Detrimental Manifestations
rows: Your creation has an unpleasant smell, even if there is no source for it.
Your creation is prone to haze, fog, and other lightly obscured conditions.
Your creation has uncommonly long days or nights (DM decides).
Structures in your creation only have arrow loops instead of windows.
Beasts either infest or avoid your creation (DM decides).
Strange weather patterns occur in your creation (DM decides what and when).
All DCs to detect or track creatures in your creation increase by 2.
All structures in your creation have −2 AC.
You have disadvantage on your passive Perception score within your creation.

en.name: Beneficial Manifestations
en.caption: Beneficial Manifestations
rows: Your creation has a smell that is pleasing to you, even if there is no source for it.
You can spend 1 minute to dispel any lightly obscuring conditions within 120 feet in your creation.
Within your creation, you can cast create food and water once per day without using a spell slot.
You can understand any language spoken within 30 feet of you while within your creation.
Beasts find your creation appealing or off-putting (you decide).
When your creation is made, you decide what weather is possible within it.
You cannot be charmed or frightened while within your creation.
All structures in your creation have +2 AC.
You have advantage on your passive Perception score within your creation.

en.caption: Bonds
rows: I have a favorite religious hymn that I constantly hum.
I must keep a written record of my beliefs and the sins that I witness. When finished, this book will be my gift to the multiverse.
I have cherished memories of Idyllglen, though I've only seen this bucolic town in dreams.
I would die for those who fight beside me, regardless of their faults.
I seek to honor the angel Zariel by destroying fiends and other evildoers wherever I find them.
The Sword of Zariel has chosen me. I shall not fail to wield it justly.

rows: I do everything for my family. My first thought is keeping them safe.
What I do, I do for the world. The people don't realize how much they need me.
I've seen too many in need. I must not fail them as everyone else has.
I stand in opposition, lest the wicked go unopposed.
I am exceptional. I do this because no one else can, and no one can stop me.
I do everything for those who were taken from me.

rows: I do everything for my family. My first thought is keeping them safe.
What I do, I do for the world. The people don't realize how much they need me.
I've seen too many in need. I must not fail them as everyone else has.
I stand in opposition, lest the wicked go unopposed.
I am exceptional. I do this because no one else can, and no one can stop me.
I do everything for those who were taken from me.

en.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I treat all beings, even enemies, with respect.
I enjoy sharing my philosophical worldview and experiences with others.
I cut right to the chase in every conversation.
I often quote (or misquote) religious texts.
I anger quickly when I witness cruelty or injustice.
My praise and trust are earned and never given freely.
I like everything clean and organized.

en.caption: Flaws
rows: I am too quick to judge others.
I will sacrifice innocent lives for the greater good.
Flaw? What flaw? I am flawless. Utter perfection!
I allow nothing to stand in the way of my crusade to eradicate evil from the multiverse.
I ignore those who do not support my plans, for my calling is higher than all others.

en.caption: Ideals
rows: Charity. I always help those in need. (Good)
Faith. I choose to follow the tenets of a particular lawful good deity to the letter. (Lawful)
Responsibility. It is the duty of the strong to protect the weak. (Lawful)
Respect. All people deserve to be treated with dignity. (Good)
Honor. The way I conduct myself determines my reward in the afterlife. (Lawful)
Redemption. All creatures are capable of change for the better. (Good)
